name: TDD
summary: Red-green-refactor loop for features and bugfixes: write a failing test first, make it pass with the minimum change, then refactor — one vertical slice at a time.
prevents: Flying-blind implementation — code written without a feedback mechanism, leading to hard-to-verify correctness.

cursor.rule_description: Use when implementing a new feature, fixing a bug, or adding behaviour that needs a verifiable correctness signal via automated tests.
cursor.skill_description: agentgrammar TDD — red-green-refactor loop for any feature or bugfix. Write failing test first, minimum passing code second, refactor third. Use when the user invokes /agentgrammar-tdd.
